<translate>
The '''Z armor sets''' are the 51 character-themed sets whose pattern is painted on a '''Blank Pattern (Z)'''. They only differ in looks: every set uses the Kikono armor material and gives the same protection.
</translate>

<translate>
== Crafting a set ==

# Paint the set's pattern on a Blank Pattern (Z) at the '''Pattern Station'''.
# Assemble each piece at '''Dr. Kikono's Station''' with the pattern, Kikono Cloth, Kikono String and the matching iron armor piece. Each piece costs 1,000 Star Energy.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armor]] for the full process, the recipes and how armor adds to your defense.
</translate>

<translate>

The patterns below are painted on a Blank Pattern (Z). With JEI installed, each design can be looked up in the ''Pattern Station'' recipe category.
</translate>

== Sets with a helmet ==

Six sets also include a helmet: Crane School (Chaoz), Demon GI (Piccolo), Evil Namekian (Slug), Hero of Justice (Great Saiyaman), Hero of Justice 2 (Great Saiyaman 2) and Red Ribbon Army (Android 20).

<translate>
== Battle damage ==

Goku's Turtle Hermit GI, the Great Saiyaman outfit and Vegeta's Saiyan armor switch to a torn, battle-damaged look once they drop below half durability.
</translate>
